# Vancomycin:

Postoperative antimicrobial administration for preventing SSI is not
necessary for most procedures. The duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis
should be less than 24 hours.

# Vancomycin Postop dose:

# Alternative for allergy to penicillin/cephalosporins and/or MRSA positive:

# Recommended Vancomycin Dose based on patient weight:

<Click here> Display last recorderd patient weight (limited 2 years)

# Weight <70 kg:

Vancomycin 1000 mg IV q12h x1 dose Postop

# Weight 70-100 kg:

Vancomycin 1500 mg IV q12h x1 dose Postop

# Weight >100 kg:

Vancomycin 2000 mg IV q12h x1 dose Postop
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG VANCOMYCIN POST-OP SPECIFIC DOSING
